episodeTitle.en: An operator’s guide to product strategy | Chandra Janakiraman (CPO at VRChat, ex-Meta, Headspace)
episodeTitle.zh: 《产品战略操作指南》 | 钱德拉·贾纳基拉曼（Chandra Janakiraman，VRChat首席产品官，前Meta、Headspace高管）

guestBioOfficial.en: Chandra Janakiraman is the chief product officer, executive vice president, and a board member at VRChat. Previously, he was a product leader at Meta, where he led Facebook’s social experience interfaces and Reality Labs’ growth; served as CPO at Headspace, where he helped relaunch the platform, driving a 4x subscriber boost; and was a GM at Zynga, delivering massive hit games that reached hundreds of millions. In our conversation, Chandra shares: • His playbook for developing a product strategy
guestBioOfficial.zh:
钱德拉·贾纳基拉曼是VRChat的首席产品官、执行副总裁兼董事会成员。此前，他曾在Meta担任产品负责人，负责Facebook的社交体验界面和Reality Labs的业务增长；在Headspace担任首席产品官，助力该平台重启并推动订阅用户数增长四倍；还曾在Zynga担任总经理，打造了数亿用户的大型热门游戏。在对话中，钱德拉分享：  
• 制定产品战略的实用指南

title.en: An operator’s guide to product strategy | Chandra Janakiraman (CPO at VRChat, ex-Meta, Headspace)
title.zh: 《产品战略操作指南》 | 钱德拉·贾纳基拉曼（Chandra Janakiraman，VRChat首席产品官，前Meta、Headspace高管）

summary.en: Chandra demystifies product strategy, arguing it isn't a born talent but a learnable process, and breaks it into “present-forward” problem-solving (2-year horizon) and big-“S” aspirational strategy (5–10 years). He shares a five-stage process to build alignment and why strategy must include an exciting view of the future. The conversation is a practical method for anyone who wants to get better at strategy.
summary.zh: Chandra 揭开了产品战略的神秘面纱，认为它并非天赋，而是可习得的过程，并将其拆为“面向当下”的问题解决（两年视野）与宏大的“aspirational”战略（5–10 年）。他分享了一个建立对齐的五阶段流程，以及为何战略必须包含对未来的激动人心的愿景。对话是任何想提升战略能力者的实用方法。
